description: Source code for a React functional component 'CreateMCPServer' that provides a user interface to create and configure a new MCP server, including form inputs, validation, OAuth flow integration, and submission handling.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission to create new MCP server, prepares payload, manages loading state, calls API, and handles success/error notifications.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form and UI states to cancel server creation process and close the modal.

methods.name: handleTransportChange
methods.description: Updates transport type state and clears irrelevant form fields based on selected transport.

methods.name: getAccessGroupOptions
methods.description: Generates selectable options for access groups, including a 'create new group' option if applicable.
